mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEVICE(DEVICE_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES(#{deviceId}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT D.DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, D.CROP_ID AS cropId, D.FARMER_EMAIL AS farmerEmail, D.IS_ACTIVE AS isActive, D.REGISTERED_AT AS registeredAt, D.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, C.CROP_NAME AS cropName, F.FARM_NAME AS farmNAme FROM DEVICE D LEFT JOIN CROP C ON D.CROP_ID = C.CROP_ID LEFT JOIN FARM F ON C.FARM_ID = C.FARM_ID ORDER BY D.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE DEVICE SET CROP_ID = #{cropId}, FARMER_EMAIL = #{farmerEmail}, IS_ACTIVE = 1, REGISTERED_AT = NOW() WHERE DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId} AND IS_ACTIVE = 0
mapper.select: SELECT DEVICE_ID AS deviceId, IS_ACTIVE AS isActive FROM DEVICE WHERE DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId}
